title: Act: Add applyFocusedObject to BootScene and call it from onStateChange
summary: Focus the SceneObject matching the store focusedObjectId
description: Add a private applyFocusedObject(id) method to BootScene that focuses the matching object and blurs other focused objects, and call it from onStateChange after the sync loop.
acceptance_criteria: onStateChange reads useGameStore.getState().focusedObjectId and passes it to applyFocusedObject
Matching object gets focus(); other focused objects get blur()
technical_constraints: Same highlight and label path as hover: SceneObject.focus()

steps.action: Add private method applyFocusedObject(id: string | null): void. For each o in this.sceneObjects: if id !== null and o.spec.id === id and !o.isFocused call o.focus(); else if o.spec.id !== id and o.isFocused call o.blur().
steps.expected: Method exists and focuses only the matching object

steps.action: After the this.sceneObjects.forEach((o) => o.sync(state)) line, add a call this.applyFocusedObject(useGameStore.getState().focusedObjectId).
steps.expected: Every store change re-applies the store focus to scene objects
